items.title: Bill Bourgeois Interview, 1959-12-10
items.q: And Billy Hill, the old songwriter that did, the one who wrote the Last Roundup and Old Spinning Wheel and those things, he was quite a fan of ours.

ctx.x: Did Nick ever play with the band much?

Oh yeah, Nick played piano, you see. And he had two pianos on the stand for that purpose, so he could come and sit in and play. And if he'd look at the keys, he'd miss, he couldn't play, he'd have to look up at the ceiling while he played. And he'd look up at the ceiling and just keep playing, boy, and he'd get a tremendous kick out of that. And Ted Husing used to come in quite a while, quite a bit every so often, maybe two, three times a week. And Billy Hill, the old songwriter that did, the one who wrote the…
Now Nick, was the piano playing on the nightclub? I can't understand that. You mean the piano was in tune?
